text.en: Clients consistently commend the veterinarians and clinical assistants for their patience and specialised knowledge of non-traditional pets. Pet owners note that clinicians thoroughly answer husbandry questions, explain medical estimates clearly, and follow up promptly with laboratory results after visits.

Reviewers highlight gentle, stress-reducing handling during appointments for parrots, conures, bearded dragons, geckos, and ferrets. Owners traveling long distances remark that clinicians make delicate birds and reptiles feel calm throughout detailed examinations and physical interventions.

Pet owners report successful clinical treatments and complex surgeries, including emergency foreign body removals in ferrets and delicate respiratory treatments for geckos. Families note thorough wellness screenings that identify infections early and support long-term recovery.

q.en: Does the hospital treat exotic reptiles and birds?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently bring parrots, conures, bearded dragons, geckos, and ferrets for clinical examinations.

q.en: Can veterinarians perform emergency surgery on small exotic pets?

a.en: Yes, reviewers report successful outcomes for urgent procedures, including foreign body removal surgeries in ferrets.

q.en: Does the clinic provide written treatment recaps after appointments?

a.en: Yes, clients mention receiving detailed follow-up emails summarising diagnoses, testing results, and care recommendations.
